description: This file defines a generic interface for creating object instances within the Orleans.Serialization.Activators namespace. It provides a method to instantiate objects of a specified type, facilitating dependency injection or dynamic object creation.

classes.name: IActivator<T>
classes.description: A generic interface for object activators that create instances of type T.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of type T.
